plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Computer Science 8-semester degree plan (2026-2027 Catalog), 'Version 2024/10/22', College of Aviation, Science, and Nursing. Header states it is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. GENUINE CATALOG TOTAL DISCREPANCY, kept verbatim per standing rules (verified via pdftotext -layout): Senior Fall lists five 3-credit courses (CPSI 37503, CPSI 38303, Jr/Sr CS Elective, Jr/Sr Math Elective, CPSI 42803 = 15) but prints TOTAL 16. The sequenced sum is therefore 15+16+16+16+16+15+15+12 = 121, not 120; total_credits reflects the sequenced sum. Graduation requirements printed on the plan: overall GPA 2.00+, all major courses C or better, at least 42 junior/senior hours, minor requirements completed, one Writing Intensive (WI) course, at least 120 total hours earned; students are responsible for adding courses if needed to meet hour/financial-aid requirements. 'PR = pre-requisite.' ENGL 10203 lists 'PR: ENG 1463' (prior numbering; satisfied in-plan by ENGL 10103 Freshman English A). Choice slots (first-listed code shown): Freshman Spring US History/American Govt. (PLSC 20003 / PLSC 200H3 / HIST 21103 / HIST 21203); Junior Fall and Junior Spring science two-course sequence (PHYS 20104+lab/20304+lab General/University Physics I or CHEM 14104+lab University Chemistry I, then the II course) — the two semesters must be the same sequence; Junior Spring MATH 21003 Statistical Methods or BIOS 20503 Applied Biostatistics. Lecture/lab pairs (e.g. CSCE 10104/10100) carry one combined credit value; lecture code shown with lab noted. 'Social Science Elective', 'Social Science', 'Humanities', 'Elective/Minor', 'Jr/Sr Computer Science Elective (CPSI, CSCE)', and 'MATH Jr/Sr Mathematics Elective' name only the slot, not a course: ELECTIVE placeholders with choice=true.
